name: forensic-file-tracker
description: Cloudflare-only forensic copy file tracking: Logpush -> R2 -> Workers (+ D1)

LOGS_BUCKET.description: R2 bucket both Logpush jobs write into (`forensic/` = DLP forensic copies, `http/` = Gateway HTTP). Use the name of the bucket your Logpush jobs already target.

LOOKUP_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for `/forensic/lookup` and `/forensic/file`, which return real uploaded file contents. Generate a long random string, e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`.

HTTP_LOG_PREFIX.description: R2 prefix of the Gateway HTTP Logpush job. Must match the job destination path.

FORENSIC_LOG_PREFIX.description: R2 prefix of the DLP forensic copies Logpush job. Must match the job destination path.

MAX_LOOKUP_OBJECTS.description: Max R2 objects scanned per prefix for one lookup request.
